ns2:section.sectionText: As a History major, you bring a valued set of skills to the workplace, but we talk about our knowledge and competence differently than the workplace does. In this course you will learn to translate your academic abilities into career-specific terms. You will inventory your interests and skills, identify careers that reflect your ambitions, and practice marketing your qualifications to employers. Topics to be covered include job-hunting skills like writing resumes, crafting application letters and interviewing; professionalization skills lilke researching companies networking; and self-efficacy strategies. You will emerge with a five-year plan for making the transition from colleghe to post-graduation success.
